units.text: The Louisiana Purchase treaty signed April 30, 1803, in Paris priced the territory at $15 million, not $10 million as claimed. The $10 million figure was the initial U.S. authorization limit for New Orleans and Floridas only.

judgement.reason: The passages state the treaty signed April 30, 1803 in Paris was for $15 million, and that negotiators were originally authorized up to $10 million solely for New Orleans and the Floridas.
